preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)
Contract must have accumulated BNB from token fees in its balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable automatic fee processing, then repeatedly call transfer() or transferFrom() with the contract as sender and the marketing address (0x1E0A894269812ae0CeAb7f10e25b885d3beBA110) as recipient to trigger swapAndLiquify() manually. This will convert accumulated tokens to BNB and transfer 2/3 of the swapped BNB to the marketing wallet. The attacker must control the marketing wallet to benefit economically.
